display_name: The KiwiSaver Act 2006 (NZ) under one top-level goal — for a person, an employment and a pay, does automatic enrolment apply and when may they opt out, what is deducted and what must the employer contribute, and how much may be withdrawn — and three goals: membership, contributions, withdrawals

others: the compulsory employer contribution for … and … (ks-contributions.l4)
the most the member may withdraw, facts … , account … (ks-withdrawals.l4)

scope: Parts 1-3 and Schedule 1 of the Act as in the PCO's version as at 1 April 2026, from the text converted from the PCO XML; Parts 4-5 carried as text. The s 101D formula (symbols lost) read as gross × CEC rate − other contributions − hybrid amount. Inputs: residence, birth date, the superannuation qualification age, the kind of employment and exemptions, each pay and rate choice, suspensions, other employer contributions, the member's accumulation and its parts, and decisions of managers and supervisors.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-16 (tests-independent.l4, 167 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read). It found 7 disagreements, all resolved in its favour (28-day contracts that end, the Oranga Tamariki guardian, rate-reduction days, unlisted rates, s 64(1)(a)(ii)-(iii)); the encoder's tests that encoded the rejected readings were changed and marked. 167/167 now pass. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: ss 10, 12(2)(b), 16: a 28-day contract enrols only if it continues to the 28th day, from which age and the opt-out window count.
forks.F3: s 101D(1): gross × CEC rate − other contributions − hybrid schemes amount, at least 0.
forks.F4: ss 16, 18(2): a late opt-out needs a s 18(1)(b) ground, acceptance, and receipt within 92 days of the first contribution.
forks.F5: cl 14C: the lesser of the liability and the accumulation less Crown contributions.
forks.F6: s 101L(3): the ending date is the last day of the reduction.
